name: durationMs
meaning: key duration in ms; the animator accumulator counts 1/1024 ms, so a key lasts durationMs << 10 accumulator units

name: entryCount
meaning: number of packed joint entries that follow

name: payloadWords
meaning: payload size in u16 words, used only to find the next record (never reconciled with entryCount)

name: entries
meaning: packed entries: u16 control word (AnimKeyChannel) followed by its present channel values (s16/u16, or bytes when ctrl & 0x8000)
